a: A scroll inside a shadow root never reaches the surface's document scroll listener, so a shadow-hosted tile's box lags the scroll by a frame
Scope membership walks the DOM tree, clipping walks the flattened tree: a slotted tile under a scope element inside a shadow root drops out of scope
Paint containment on `<body>` cuts a tile to the viewport rather than to the body's box
b: A scroll inside a shadow root never reaches the surface's scroll listener, so tiles in a shadow-tree scroller lag a frame behind
Scope membership walks the DOM tree while clipping walks the flattened tree, so a slotted tile drops out of a scope that holds its slot
A container resize that moves no tile delivers no frame, so the owner never resizes its buffers to the new size
A tile scrolled out of a normally scrolling page keeps a full `visible` rect
`overflow: clip` is cut to the padding box, ignoring `overflow-clip-margin`
A `content-visibility: hidden` ancestor leaves its tiles a nonzero `visible` rect
